authority: Procedure predeclared by the project owner in the R4-N1 task instruction on 15 November 2026. Do not change after inspecting model results without an explicit, documented owner-approved amendment.

scope.note: LR-A and BiGRU-A export evidence and Parquet files are locally verified. WavLM-A and AST-A exports are not present in this checkout; their metadata and hashes remain pending. This recipe does not claim the four-model input set is verified.

wavlm.note: Documentation reports WavLM-A validation exports, but no corresponding export folder or prediction files are present locally. Populate these fields only after inspecting and hash-verifying the delivered files and evidence.

ast.note: Documentation reports AST-A validation exports, but no corresponding export folder or prediction files are present locally. Populate these fields only after inspecting and hash-verifying the delivered files and evidence.

schema.score_semantics: Mean chunk probability for TTS, saved as raw_score at recording level; probabilities must be finite and in [0,1].

weighting.fit_objective: Equal weight per recording within each fit.
weighting.loso_selection: Calculate one log loss per held-out speaker and average those speaker losses equally.

temperature.fit_objective: Mean binary log loss on calibration recordings.
temperature.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar(method='bounded'); golden-section fallback only if SciPy is unavailable

affine.parameterisation: a = exp(u), q = sigmoid(a * logit(clip(p, epsilon, 1-epsilon)) + b)

selection_rule.cross_validation: Leave one speaker out within the calibration role; fit on all other calibration speakers and score the held-out speaker.
selection_rule.statistic: Mean over held-out speakers of per-speaker recording-level log loss.
selection_rule.standard_error: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the best candidate's per-speaker losses divided by sqrt(number of calibration speakers).
selection_rule.choice: Choose the simplest eligible candidate whose mean is <= best mean + one standard error.
selection_rule.failed_candidates: Exclude and report a candidate if any LOSO fold or its full-calibration refit fails; exclude non-finite and bound-hitting fits. Identity remains eligible; if every non-identity candidate fails, select identity.
selection_rule.tie_resolution: Exact mean ties for best use candidate_simplicity_order; the one-SE eligible choice uses the first eligible candidate in that order.

acceptance_rule.applies_to: The selected non-identity mapping; identity is rejected by definition.
acceptance_rule.valid_fit: Optimizer success where exposed, finite objective and parameters, parameters strictly inside bounds by more than bound_tolerance, finite calibrated probabilities in [0,1].
conditions: Operating log loss of mapped scores is strictly lower than raw-score log loss.
Operating Brier score of mapped scores is no higher than raw-score Brier score.
acceptance_rule.tie: Reject mapping if operating log loss ties raw.

threshold_rule.objective: Maximize macro F1 over all distinct score-induced partitions on the operating role, plus explicit all-negative.
threshold_rule.implementation_note: The inspected threshold.py contract branch currently favors the larger threshold at the final tie (its max sort key uses -threshold), which conflicts with this predeclared smaller-threshold rule. R4-N1 must enforce this recipe in A-specific orchestration; leave the B helper unchanged.
threshold_rule.plateau: Record the count of thresholds tied at maximum macro F1 before secondary tie-breaks; also record the count remaining after the genuine-FPR tie-break.

reliability.definition: Equal-width bins on [0,1], last bin closed, empty bins omitted.

bootstrap.scope: Descriptive intervals only; resample speakers as clusters.

diagnostics.per_component: For each TTS generator, report genuine-versus-that-generator diagnostics for Melo, VITS, XTTS, and Chatterbox; informational only.
diagnostics.per_speaker: Report per-speaker genuine false alarms/counts and rates; descriptive only.

restrictions: Fit mapping candidates and the selected final mapping using calibration-role recordings only.
Freeze and persist the selected mapping before opening operating predictions.
Open operating predictions only after mapping freeze, for the predeclared acceptance checks and threshold selection.
Never read, score, hash, or otherwise access the Protocol A test partition.
Never modify Protocol B source, configuration, artifacts, or locks/B_lock_gr3.json.
Never overwrite existing runs, outputs, or artifacts; fail if the destination exists.
Do not change this procedure based on model results without an explicit, documented owner-approved amendment.
